name: 雨竹听风
details: Keep the jade bamboo contour, mist-white opaque interior, orange-haired tiger girl in the pale jade outfit, bamboo hairpin and closed umbrella; delicate sparse watercolor foliage only at corners.
prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Input image 1 is the exact edit target, an existing transparent horizontal candidate popup skin. Preserve this character identity, expression, costume, rendering style, colors, and all themed decorations.
Technical production change only: make the blank text panel TALLER by extending its straight side walls downward, roughly doubling the blank panel's inner height. Aim for a wide landscape asset about 2:1 aspect ratio, rather than an extremely thin strip. Keep the entire character above the top edge of the text panel in exactly the same pose; don't stretch the character.
There must be a completely clear horizontal strip through the MIDDLE of the enlarged blank panel, spanning the FULL width including both side rims. This strip contains only plain straight vertical side borders, flat opaque interior fill, and alpha 0 outside. All corner ornaments, flowers, bows, anchors, paws, compass, ribbons, umbrellas, waves and foliage must sit above or below this plain strip, never intersect it. Move existing side ornaments to top/bottom corners as needed while retaining the theme. The panel's middle interior must be absolutely blank. This strip is for software nine-slice vertical stretching, so no patterned border, rope twist, diagonal edge or independent decoration can cross it.
Also keep a clear vertical strip in the left-of-center area (about 35 percent width) with only straight horizontal top/bottom borders and blank interior; no ornament intersects this vertical strip.
One complete asset on genuine transparent RGBA background. Opaque #F4F4E9 text interior. Crisp clean alpha edges, no halo/glow/noise. NO text, lettering, numbers, selection highlight or guides. Keep whole silhouette fully inside canvas with tiny clear padding.
